notes.title: PeakPals – Big Update 🎉
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋

We’re excited to share the biggest update to PeakPals so far!

✨ What’s new:

Climb extended up to 2500 meters – fresh, rage-inducing sections full of new obstacles.

Streamlined single-player experience – old experimental mechanics like puzzles, weapons, and items have been removed. PeakPals now focuses entirely on what it does best: a pure, rage-inducing precision platformer for solo play.

Improved gameplay flow – smoother controls, better pacing, new types of traps and challenges.

General fixes and optimizations – making the climb feel fair (but still painful 😅).

💡 Why the change?
PeakPals was always meant to be a tough but fun precision platformer. Community feedback made it clear: the game shines most when it focuses on timing, accuracy, and the thrill of climbing higher and higher. This update brings that vision to life.

⚡ What’s next?
We’ve started working on restoring multiplayer, and it will launch together with the game’s full release out of Early Access in the upcoming update. Stay tuned!

Thank you so much for supporting the game, streaming it, and raging with us 🙏 We can’t wait to see how high you’ll climb after this update!

notes.title: Hotfix 5.0
notes.content:
Quick Hotfix addressing the following issues:
-Adjusted position for the end credits

notes.title: Patch 5.0

And more!

notes.title: Major Game Optimization Update
notes.content:
First of all, we want to thank everyone for their patience. The long-awaited optimization update is finally here, allowing the game to run smoothly even on lower-end graphics cards.

We've successfully achieved 40-60 FPS on a GTX 950 2GB at medium settings while preserving the game's visual quality. We carefully removed only the most demanding elements that affected older GPUs, ensuring a balanced experience without compromising the game's aesthetics.

In the future, we plan to bring back ultra-realistic water and dynamic weather, but these features will require a more powerful GPU. To make this possible, we will develop a separate launcher for advanced graphics options.

Additionally, we've fixed a few minor bugs, and all levels across all difficulty settings have been optimized for better performance.

We’d love for you to try the game again! If you experience FPS issues or have any feedback, please send us your PC specs and FPS results at support@kyrsoftstudios.com—your input is incredibly valuable to us.

Happy jumping, and see you in the game! 🚀

notes.title: Update v3.6

notes.title: Update 3.4
notes.content: Another small update fixing a few minor things, such as corrected collisions for various platforms, but most importantly added achievements in Beginner mode and Normal mode.

notes.title: Update 3.3
notes.content:
n this update, we fixed a few minor issues, such as:

- Fixed door sound for the client
- Redesigned apple spawners
- Reduced torch brightness and fixed torch sound (the torch sound no longer persists after hiding the torch)
- Changed weather intensity, with more clear days and less rain

We also hope to have resolved the issue with graphic settings, where it was visible even at night when using medium settings. Switching to other detail levels fixed it, but we hope it will no longer occur on medium settings either.

notes.title: Patch 3.2

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
After some time, we are bringing a major update to the game in which we've removed certain sections and replaced them with new content. We’ve also added more opportunities for players to help each other and introduced some new puzzles. Additionally, we’ve fixed a significant number of bugs, and most importantly, we’ve removed the "ragdoll" effect.

This means that now, for example, if you throw a grenade under a player, it will launch them higher. Weapons work similarly, but the effect depends on which part of the body you hit.

So, the game still allows you to make things more challenging for other players by knocking them off, but you can also help each other by using a well-aimed grenade to launch another player onto a higher platform.

We believe that with this update, we’ve managed to eliminate most bugs, simplify the game’s beginning, and bring more cooperation into the multiplayer experience.

notes.title: Update v2.1
notes.content:
A minor update has been released, mainly addressing the following issues:

- Fixed the bug related to deleting saved data using the DEL key.
- Fixed the issue with saving items in the inventory.
- Fixed the saving of positions when switching between modes [beginner/normal/hard], with saving now functioning separately for each difficulty level.

notes.title: Big update - Update V2.0
notes.content:
This update introduces new difficulty levels for the main map: Beginner, Normal, and Hard mode.

-Beginner Mode: Checkpoints are available approximately every 200 meters, and you can find plenty of teleport essences along the way to save and load your position.

-Normal Mode: Teleport essences are no longer available on the path, but checkpoints remain. There is also more wood available for building platforms than in Hard mode, but less than in Beginner mode.

-Hard Mode: There are no checkpoints, no teleport essences along the way, and very little wood. This mode is only suitable for true PeakPals fans.
Additionally, the beginning of the main map "Only Up" has been slightly simplified.
New Additions:

A brand new map called Extreme Obstacles has been added. This map is very challenging, with no weapons, teleport essences, or checkpoints. Every jump must be precise, and one mistake will send you all the way back to the bottom.

Other New Features:

-Music has been added to the game.
-An option to adjust music volume has been added.
-A windowed/fullscreen toggle has been added.
-Checkpoints have been added to selected difficulties (Beginner and Normal).
-Descriptions for challenges have been added to the game menu.
-Player count text has been added to the menu/challenges section.
-Adding more achievements for each difficulty separately

Bug Fixes:

-Fixed collision issues with pre-built wooden platforms (on the client side).
-Fixed falling through the ground.
-Fixed lighting issues on low and medium settings (it's now dark at night).
-Improved item pickup mechanics.
-Fixed inventory issues on the client side.
-Fixed a bug where teleport essences were duplicating in the inventory.

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
A small update that fixes important aspects of the game, such as incorrect collisions in the cave that previously prevented players from finding the correct path through the cave's maze

-Fixed collisions in the cave
-Fixed building of "wooden platforms" [they can now be placed without snapping to objects, even when the game is set to a language other than English]
-Tuned collisions and blockage to prevent falling through the landscape [time will tell if this issue is fully resolved]
-Minor translation fixes
-Adjusted torch [changed the light radius and lighting directly in front of the character]
